description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, implementing a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, and revoking functionalities, along with associated helper classes such as TimeWorker and WatchDogType.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a timer with scheduling, triggering, and revoking capabilities, managing a queue of timed information and a dedicated thread for processing.

classes.name: TimeWorker
classes.description: A nested class within TimerType, a thread worker that calls the parent TimerType's Process method.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A template class representing a watchdog thread that can be armed, reset, and run a handler upon expiration.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a timer event at a specific time with associated content.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a timer event immediately, replacing any existing event with the same content.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled event associated with specific content.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop of the timer thread, handling scheduled events and delays.
